p: The Foregate is part of Kilmarnock's pedestrian shopping heart, so this branch is right where most people already are when they're in town. As an adult gaming centre it's 18+ only, with the café side the more relaxed part of the visit.

Kilmarnock has a bit of history worth knowing. The very first collection of Robert Burns' poems was printed here in 1786, now famous as the Kilmarnock Edition, and the town is where John Walker started selling the whisky that became Johnnie Walker. The Dick Institute, a grand museum, gallery and library, is a short walk away, and Dean Castle Country Park on the edge of town has the restored castle, woodland walks and space for the kids to run about. Football fans will know Rugby Park, home of Kilmarnock FC.
